summary: Fixed creator attribution in README byline and NOTICE to match the manifest creator (veltri-23), resolving the Greptile review conflict on PR #1669.
reason: The .printing-press.json manifest records creator handle 'veltri-23' (Hunter Veltri), which matches the library convention (creator = the person who authored the CLI). The generated README byline and NOTICE used the engine author handle '@mvanhorn', attributing the CLI to two different GitHub accounts across canonical surfaces. Aligned README and NOTICE to the manifest so all attribution surfaces agree.
validated_outcome: grep across README.md and NOTICE shows no remaining '@mvanhorn' creator byline; manifest creator velt-23 matches byline (Hunter Veltri @veltri-23).
